evals.name: cited-hops-and-unresolved-interface
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-flow /orders/{id}

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. landscape_dialect is absent, so the mermaid default applies. The subject is a git checkout. src/Transport/OrdersEndpoint.cs has [HttpGet("/orders/{id}")] and awaits _orders.Place where _orders is IOrders, then awaits _service.Handle where _service is OrdersService. src/Application/OrdersService.cs Handle publishes OrderPlaced and calls Repository.Save. src/DecoyWorker/OrdersImpl.cs also defines Place. This is a non-interactive run.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-flow.sh and render-flow.sh. Writes docs/architecture/flow.json and flow.md. The Place hop cites the Transport call site, is unresolved dependency-injection, and does not name OrdersImpl. Handle is inferred. Publish is an asynchronous handoff to map-events. Save is synchronous.
expectations: Runs ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/collect-flow.sh with --entry /orders/{id} rather than composing the sequence by hand
Writes flow.json before rendering, then runs render-flow.sh --dialect mermaid to produce flow.md
The Place hop resolution is unresolved and the mechanism is dependency-injection
OrdersImpl is not a callee
The Publish hop is handoff yes and asynchronous, and flow.md names /architecture:map-events
The Save hop is synchronous
Does not add a dialect key
